instruction: A candid documentary photograph in a full-length shot at eye-level captures an outdoor park with a dirt path surrounded by lush green trees. On the left, the blind man in a light green denim jacket (R1) stands stationary wearing sunglasses, a black turtleneck, black pants, and white sneakers, holding a white cane vertically in his right hand with a neutral expression. On the right, the woman in a tan coat (R2) stands beside him wearing a black beanie, a green scarf, a white t-shirt, blue jeans, and black boots, looking forward with a neutral expression. Her right arm is linked through his left arm as they pose side-by-side. The scene is illuminated by soft, diffused daylight with natural, muted colors.
